svg.title: One Accountable Owner, Three Contract Specialists
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-land-trading-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: One Accountable Owner, Three Contract Specialists; subtitle: Base pod: 1 FT + 3 C; scaled pod: 2 FT + 4 C; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The four displayed seats are people in the Conservative and Base-Case pod; C means contractor, not full-time equivalent. The scaled six-person pod adds one full-time operations lead and one contract field coordinator. Title, escrow, survey, environmental, and legal firms are transaction vendors outside this pod headcount; applicable fees remain in modeled expenses.; caption: The owner controls capital allocation and final purchase terms. Specialists supply parcel evidence and transaction execution; automation accelerates screening without deciding title, access, zoning, or environmental conclusions.; stages: label: Owner and investment lead; value: 1 full-time seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own acquisition ceilings, liquidity limits, offer terms, and exit decisions. Review held inventory weekly, reconcile parcel-level profit after settlement, and retain accountability when adding the scaled operations lead.; label: GIS and comparable-sales analyst; value: 1 contract seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain QGIS screening layers, assessor extracts, recorded-sale comparisons, and evidence timestamps. Automate duplicate detection and comparable-sale tracking; escalate mismatched boundaries, unsupported access, and stale valuations to the owner.; label: Transaction coordinator; value: 1 contract seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track inspection deadlines, title requirements, vendor deliverables, escrow documents, and settlement reconciliations. Route title opinions to counsel and coverage questions to the insurer; coordination does not confer authority to provide regulated professional services.; label: Licensed disposition specialist; value: 1 contract seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use an appropriately licensed professional where representation requires it. Manage substantiated listings, buyer qualification, feedback, and closing coordination. At scaled volume, the added field coordinator handles site visits and vendor scheduling rather than brokerage.
